name: Check Release

on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'

jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run linter
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings

  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run tests
        run: cargo test --all-targets

  test-all-features:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run tests with all features
        run: cargo test --all-targets --features=*

  docs:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Build documentation
        run: cargo doc --all-targets --document-private-items

  coverage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run tests with coverage
        run: cargo test --all-targets -- --nocapture --test-threads=1

      - name: Upload coverage report
        uses: codecov/codecov-action@v2
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.CODECOV_TOKEN }}
          flags: unittests
          name: codecov-umbrella
          fail_ci_if_error: true

  conformance:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run conformance tests
        run: cargo test --all-targets --features=conformance

  nix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Nix
        uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v18
        with:
          channels: default
          nix-path: nixpkgs-unstable

      - name: Build with Nix
        run: nix build .

  check-release:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Run release checks
        run: cargo check --release

  release:
    needs: [lint, test, test-all-features, docs, coverage, conformance, nix]
    if: github.ref == 'refs/tags/v*'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: write
      packages: write
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          profile: minimal
          override: true

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: cargo build --release

      - name: Publish release
        id: publish_release
        uses: actions/create-release@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          tag_name: ${{ github.ref }}
          release_name: Release ${{ github.ref }}
          draft: false
          prerelease: false

      - name: Upload binaries
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ steps.publish_release.outputs.upload_url }}
          asset_path: target/release/hegel
          asset_name: hegel-${{ github.ref }}.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip

  zizmor:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Install zizmor
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y zizmor

      - name: Run zizmor
        run: zizmor --format plain .github/
